title: metrics4_samples time-range filtering must use the arrayMin/arrayMax alias expressions to hit the minmax indexes
answers: How do I make metrics4_samples time window queries use the timestamp_min/timestamp_max index?
Why does querying metrics4_samples read whole edge hours?
body:
metrics4_samples has alias columns timestamp_min = arrayMin(timestamp_arr) and timestamp_max = arrayMax(timestamp_arr) with minmax indexes idx_timestamp_min_minmax / idx_timestamp_max_minmax (granularity 1), defined in posthog/clickhouse/hcl/roles/logs/metrics/metrics4.hcl and posthog/clickhouse/metrics/metrics4.py.
- Index analysis matches the alias expression, so readers must filter `arrayMin(timestamp_arr) <= maxt AND arrayMax(timestamp_arr) >= mint`, or wrap that predicate in `indexHint`.
- Filtering only on time_bucket still reads every series-hour row of the edge hours.
- Indexes are not materialized for old parts (migration 0331 omits MATERIALIZE INDEX); only parts written after it carry them, so older parts work but get no pruning until they expire.
- Keep the alias definitions and index names identical across HCL, Python and migration.
applies: Queries against metrics4_samples (e.g. snuffle) and any change to its timestamp index columns
